rv.q: One of the most original, thought-provoking and necessary works I have ever seen.
"'The Chinese Lady' charges toward its if-you-haven't-gotten-it-by-now-here's-the-message conclusion that seeks hope in a culture that is unforgiving and cruel.

cn.t: Critics are divided on this thought-provoking play about America's first Chinese woman immigrant. While some praise Shannon Tyo's performance and Ralph B. Peña's direction as brilliant, others find the production grows tedious despite its timely message.
